title: Effect of Parity in Cyclically Competing Communities
summary: Communities exhibiting cyclic (i.e., ``winnerless'') competition occur throughout nature. These systems can exhibit qualitatively different long-term behavior depending on the strength of inter-species competition and a specific property of the number of interacting species: parity. We consider how ecological communities can adapt to and transition between an odd and an even number of cyclically competing species.
